name: Senterada (Spain)
description: Red field with a square yellow canton bearing a red ram rampant, and three yellow ragged bends sinister on the field.
history: The official flag of Senterada is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a square yellow canton of height 1/2 of the cloth, charged with the red ram rampant collared, belled and hoofed in light blue of height 13/20 of the cloth; approved on 17 March 2006 and published in the DOGC on 3 April 2006. It is based on the heraldic arms of the town.

features.role: square canton of 1/2 of the height
ram rampant collared, belled and hoofed in light blue on the canton
collar, bell and hooves of the ram
